Minutes of the Board of Directors Meeting 
 
 
 
 The Board of Directors meeting of Zameen Media (Private) Limited (“Company”) was held at its registered office located at 19A-1, E-II, Gulberg III, Lahore on 10 October, 2013. 
 
 The following were present in the meeting, representing all of the Directors of the Company. 
 
 Imran Ali Khan (Director/CEO) 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan (Director) 
 
 The following business was transacted in the meeting: 
 
 Agenda 1: 
 
 Directors noted that they had reviewed and considered availing a loan in the principal amount of PKR 200,000,000 (Pakistani Rupees two hundred million) (“Loan”) from Zameen Limited (“ Lender ”) , a company incorporated under the laws of UK. It was approved that the Company avail the Loan from the Lender. 
 
 It was further approved that the Board of Directors shall do all such acts and execute all such instruments as are necessary and incidental to availing the Loan, including but not limited to entering into a loan agreement with the Lender. 
 
 Agenda 2: 
 
 There being no other business for the meeting, the meeting ended with a vote of thanks to the Chairman.

 Chairman
